name: Stripe
free_plan_limits: No monthly fee; pay per sale
usage_note: 2.9% + 30¢ per card sale; Stripe Billing subscriptions add 0.7%
notes: A payment tool, not a storefront: no course or community hosting. Extra 1.5% for international cards, 1% for currency conversion. Priced from search snippets of Stripe pages (page fetch was blocked).

name: Skool
usage_note: 10% transaction fee on Hobby, 2.9% on Pro
since_note: Started in 2019 by Sam Ovens (Skool about page).
notes: Hobby $9 with a 10% fee; Pro $99 with 2.9%. Both have unlimited members and courses. Third-party guides add a 30¢ per-sale fee that Skool's page doesn't show. Free trial length not stated.

name: Whop
free_plan_limits: No monthly fee; pay per sale
usage_note: 2.7% + 30¢ per sale; +0.5% for recurring billing, +1.5% international
best_for: Selling digital products and access with no monthly fee
notes: Fees come from Whop's own blog posts; its pricing page could not be read. Sell courses, digital products and recurring access per those posts. Community: not stated.

name: Gumroad
free_plan_limits: No monthly fee; pay per sale
usage_note: 10% + 50¢ per direct sale; 30% on Discover marketplace sales
best_for: Selling a few digital downloads fast
notes: Acts as merchant of record and handles sales tax. Mobile app sales carry a 40% total charge per its help center. Community features not mentioned.

name: Kajabi
usage_note: Card rate 2.9% + 30¢ on Basic through Kajabi Payments
best_for: Established course businesses that want everything in one place
notes: Basic $179 monthly ($143 yearly), Growth $249, Pro $499. Basic: 5 products, 2,500 contacts, 1 community. 14-day trial. An older, cheaper Kickstarter plan is not on the page.

name: PayPal
free_plan_limits: No monthly fee; pay per sale
usage_note: 3.49% + 49¢ per PayPal Checkout sale in the US; cards 2.99% + 49¢
since_note: Founded 1998 as Confinity; sources vary between 1998 and 1999 (Wikipedia).
notes: A payment tool, not a storefront. +1.5% on international sales. Rates from search snippets of PayPal's US fee pages (page fetch was blocked); a cached page showed a 30¢ fixed fee, so check before relying.

name: Stan Store
usage_note: No Stan fee on sales; Stripe/PayPal fees (about 2.9%) still apply
best_for: Creators selling from a link in bio
notes: Creator $29 monthly or $300 a year; Creator Pro $99 monthly adds upsells, affiliates and email flows. 14-day free trial.

name: Beacons
free_plan_limits: Free store with a 9% transaction fee
usage_note: 9% fee on sales on the free and $10 plans
best_for: Link-in-bio page with a small store
notes: Plan names and prices differ between Beacons pages: help center says $10 Creator Pro, $30 Creator Plus, $100 Creator Max; older posts say $90. Confirm on the live pricing page.
